information.description:
Basic guards with better gear and armored suits for protection details that require more finesse and sophistication. Due to their more covert dress, they’re particularly weak to headshots compared to their non-senior compatriots.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Arasaka).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Sometimes accuracy isn't important. Sometimes you want to spray lead and witness the havoc once the smoke clears. In that case, seek no further than the Shigure. This SMG from the early 21st century might be getting on in years, and it might not have the firepower of more recent models, but it can unload more bullets in a minute than all of Arasaka's unprosecuted counts of tax fraud. Meaning a lot.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon expends 15 rounds per Autofire use. If there are not 15 rounds left in the magazine for Autofire (SMG 4), the entire magazine is expended as Autofire (SMG 3) instead.

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
An Exotic, One-handed Medium Melee Weapon. Target is knocked unconscious if damage dealt would reduce them to under 1 HP. Doesn't cause Critical Injuries or ablate armor.
Light Armorjack that looks like businesswear. Restores 1SP every day SP isn't lost on the armor.
Deals no damage. If hit roll DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs. On a fail take the Damaged Eye and Damaged Ear Critical injuries (see pg. 188) for 1 minute. No Crit damage dealt.
Plating on your hand which allows you to utilise Smartguns. Requires a neural link.
